prompt: A low-poly 3D floating island: a small chunk of land built from faceted, flat-shaded polygons with crisp edges, its rocky underside tapering to a point, hovering in empty space. On the island: A wooden balcony floor is bathed in warm honey-toned light. In the center, a rustic outdoor bistro table holds a warm, imperfect peach galette on a ceramic plate, slightly larger than life. Beside it sits a small propped smartphone glowing with gentle light. To the left rests a paper tote filled with large deep-purple carrots and a round sourdough loaf. A black wrought-iron railing with tiny potted basil plants lines the back edge, catching the long golden rays of late sun. Clean stylized game-asset look: every element, including people, furniture, food and plants, is built from flat-shaded faceted polygons in soft pastel colors, with no realistic textures. The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Nothing extends beyond its edges: no horizon, sky or distant scenery behind it. Plain seamless pale gray background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.
